title: Chapter 554 - 554 Punish; Awards (2)

Chapter 554 - 554 Punish; Awards (2)

Chapter 554 - 554 Punish; Awards (2)

554 Punish; Awards (2)

In their hearts, no award could compare to Lin Fan’s praise.

At this moment, Hao Zhiwu shouted excitedly, “Hahaha, I won the award! I won the award!”

Everyone could not help but look in his direction.

“What award did you receive?” Liu Qianqian asked.

“The International Neuroscience Research Award!” Hao Zhiwu said excitedly.

When Lin Fan heard that, his eyes lit up. “Not bad!”

It was another international award.

The mission was two-thirds completed!

After the news of three people winning international awards, the atmosphere in the office became even more intense.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue wanted to work harder and get more awards. This way, Lin Fan would continue to praise them.

Liu Qianqian, Nie Zhenjiang, and Jiang Chaoqun felt the pressure because they had not won an award yet. Therefore, they worked even harder.

Originally, only Hao Zhiwu was the most relaxed.

However, he was affected by the atmosphere in the office and could not help but enter a state of hard work.

A day passed in the blink of an eye.

When the school bell rang, Lin Fan stood up and was about to announce the end of today’s class.

At this moment, Jiang Chaoqun exclaimed excitedly, “I won an award! He won the International Polymers Research Award!”

“Congratulations!”

“Our class is celebrating three wins today!”

“I suggest we celebrate tonight. How about that?”

…

The office was filled with praise.

Liu Qianqian and Nie Zhenjiang congratulated Jiang Chaoqun as well, but the pressure in their hearts increased.

They were the only ones who had not won an award.

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up even more.

Three!

His students had won three international awards in one fell swoop.

Once they received the awards, he would be able to complete the mission!

Lin Fan said happily, “That’s right! We have three happy occasions to celebrate! Tonight, I’ll bring everyone out for some delicious food.”

“Hooray!” Everyone shouted in unison.

Those who won an award were naturally happy.

Those who did not win an award wanted to eat delicious food. They instantly threw the annoyance in their hearts to the side.

Among them, Xia Bing and Xia Xue were the happiest.

That was because they had the chance to eat with Lin Fan again!

…

Lin Fan only drove the Cullinan, and seven people could not fit inside.

Fortunately, Hao Zhiwu had bought a second-hand Volkswagen not long ago, so they could take two cars.

Under Lin Fan’s lead, they soon arrived at Big Pufferfish.

The last time Liu Yuhang brought Lin Fan here to eat, Lin Fan remembered the taste of the food. Yesterday, he had wanted to come over for another meal, and he had the chance to do so today.

“Pufferfish? Is it delicious?” Hao Zhiwu asked.

Lin Fan smiled. “You’ll find out later.”

The pufferfish meal was served relatively slowly.

All the pufferfish were killed and processed on the spot. The process was very complicated.

The chef absolutely could not be careless about the preparation.

About half an hour later, a large pot of pufferfish soup was served.

When the waiter opened the lid of the pot, the aroma instantly entered everyone’s nose and mouth.

Hao Zhiwu, Nie Zhenjiang, and the others could not help but swallow their saliva.

Lin Fan smiled. “Why are you still staring? Hurry up and eat it.”

“Alright,” everyone responded.

Everyone picked up some pufferfish meat and put it in their mouths.

“It’s so delicious!” Hao Zhiwu praised sincerely. “I finally know what melt-in-the-mouth means!”

Everyone was very happy during the meal.

…

In the blink of an eye, several days passed.

On this day, Lin Fan drove the Cullinan back to Qing City and brought his parents to Jiangbei.

Then, he drove Lin Xiaoyao, Lin Tao, and Dai Weixue to Jiangbei International Airport.

Lin Tao and Dai Weixue had specially changed into brand new white clothes, appearing very solemn.

They were going overseas with Lin Fan to attend the Nobel Prize award ceremony.

Compared to Lin Tao and Dai Weixue’s solemnity and nervousness, Lin Xiaoyao was busy looking around, curious about everything.

This was her first time taking a plane, and it was her first time at the airport.

At this moment, three flight attendants from Xia Airlines walked over.

Under the warm welcome of the stewardess, Lin Fan, Lin Xiaoyao, Lin Tao, and Dai Weixue arrived in front of the luxurious plane.

“Mr. Lin and family, welcome aboard Xia Airlines!” Two rows of long-legged air stewardesses stood on both sides of the red carpet in front of the luxury plane and shouted in unison.

Lin Fan was already used to such scenes, so he was not surprised.

Lin Tao and Dai Weixue were at a loss.

Lin Xiaoyao’s face was filled with excitement and curiosity.

After entering the luxurious private jet, Lin Xiaoyao was even more excited when the abalone, lobster, sea cucumber, bird’s nest, Lafite, and other delicacies and wines were served.

“Delicious!

“This lobster is so big!

“Dad, Mom, try this beef…

“Brother, there’s so much delicious food on the plane! No wonder everyone likes going on flights.”

…

Lin Xiaoyao would let out excited cries from time to time, causing the empty plane to become a little more lively.

About ten hours later, the luxury plane finally stopped in Potholm, Swede.

At this moment, three Audis had already stopped here.

A middle-aged man wearing glasses and a white shirt, who looked full of wisdom, strode forward when he saw the plane landing.

“Professor Lin, it must’ve been a tiring journey. Welcome to Swede. I am Liu Zihao, an official in Swede.”

Lin Fan said, “It wasn’t tiring. We were resting on the plane. Mr. Liu, you came to pick us up early in the morning. It’s been hard on you.”

Lin Fan was not being modest or polite when he said this.

His words came from the bottom of his heart.

That was because the private luxury plane was like a moving castle that could give him the best enjoyment. How could he be tired?

On the other hand, Liu Zihao’s forehead was still dripping with sweat.

Clearly, he had been waiting quite some time.

This was normal.

After all, Lin Fan came here on a private plane. He could only estimate the time and could not be sure.

This meant that the pick-up person had to arrive early.

“Mr. Lin, you’re too kind,” said Liu Zihao.

He first shook hands with Lin Fan, then shook hands with Lin Tao, Dai Weixue, and Lin Xiaoyao.

“Why don’t we get in the car first?”

“Alright,” Lin Fan said.

The doors of this Audi were very thick. Whether it was the softness of the seats or the soundproofing effect, they were far better than an ordinary Audi.

Obviously, it had been specially modified.

“Before I came, I heard that you were very young,” Liu Zihao said. “I was already mentally prepared, but I was still shocked when I saw you.

“It’s really hard to imagine that you’ve achieved so much at such a young age!

“The Nobel Prize is the most dazzling award in the academic world!

“In history, no one has ever won multiple Nobel Prizes at the same time, but you won four! Professor Lin, you’re the pride of Hua Nation!”

Liu Zihao’s voice was very sincere, without any intention of flattery. When he reached the end of his sentence, there was an unconcealable excitement in his tone.

He had been stationed in Swede for several years, and he had always been looking forward to the day when someone from Hua Nation would win the Nobel Prize.

Now, it had finally become reality!

Moreover, it was a reality that far exceeded his expectations!

Even Lin Fan could not help but feel embarrassed when he was praised in front of his parents and sister.

He touched his nose and said, “Actually, this is nothing.”

It was nothing?

Even winning one Nobel Prize was already a very impressive feat.

Lin Fan had won four of them, but he said that it was nothing.

“Professor Lin, you’re too modest,” Liu Zihao said.
